stem: What was one effect of this type of advertising during World War II?

options.label: A
options.text: Women’s colleges closed as wartime employment opportunities grew.

options.label: B
options.text: The number of women in nontraditional roles increased.

options.label: C
options.text: Women’s organizations secured passage of the GI Bill for returning veterans.

options.label: D
options.text: Congress passed laws guaranteeing equal pay for equal work for women.
